_comment: Which calls the message rubric applies to. A call outside scope gets no message score at all — not a zero.

out_of_scope.pricing: Commercial negotiation. Nobody restates the category while discussing price.
out_of_scope.scheduling: Logistics. There is no pitch to deliver.
out_of_scope.implementation: Post-sale planning. Delivery work, not selling.
out_of_scope.technical_scoping: Feasibility detail with no product story told.

heuristic: If three or more of the four promise elements would be not-applicable, the call was not a pitch.
